tagline: A comprehensive, hands-on learning path for AI Infrastructure Engineers — from entry level to principal.
overview: This org covers **AI infrastructure** — *running* the platforms: foundational Python and Kubernetes through distributed training, GPU and LLM infrastructure, MLOps, platform engineering, performance, and enterprise architecture. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository (modules, lecture chapters, exercises, quizzes) and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.
highlights: 🎓 Hundreds of hands-on exercises and dozens of real-world projects
🔗 **Agentic engineering, governance, and ML engineering** tracks live in the [sibling orgs](#-curriculum-family)

focus.junior-engineer: Python & ML basics, Linux & Docker, Kubernetes intro, cloud platforms, monitoring
focus.engineer: Production ML, distributed training, GPU computing, advanced Kubernetes, MLOps, LLM infra, IaC
focus.mlops: CI/CD for ML, model registry, feature stores, experiment tracking, drift detection, A/B testing
focus.ml-platform: Platform architecture, multi-tenancy, serving at scale, platform APIs/SDKs, developer experience
focus.performance: GPU utilization, inference latency, training efficiency, cost optimization, profiling
focus.senior-engineer: Advanced Kubernetes (operators/CRDs), distributed training at scale, CUDA, multi-cloud, SRE
focus.architect: Enterprise ML architecture, multi-cloud/hybrid, security & compliance, FinOps, HA/DR, LLM/RAG platforms
focus.team-lead: Technical strategy & roadmaps, team building, ADRs, incident & performance management
focus.senior-architect: Cross-org architecture alignment, enterprise standards, multi-year roadmaps, executive communication
focus.principal-engineer: Deep technical expertise, extreme-scale distributed systems, novel infra solutions, mentorship
focus.principal-architect: Company-wide strategy, multi-year roadmaps, technology selection, architecture governance
focus.inference-engineer: Serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang), batching & KV cache, quantization, routing, GPU autoscaling, latency/cost SLOs

track_note: All 11 infrastructure tracks are actively maintained. Work focuses on depth, runtime validation, and human review. See the [Career Progression Guide](https://github.com/ai-infra-curriculum/.github/blob/main/CAREER_PROGRESSION.md) for role and skill mapping, and the [Curriculum Cross-Reference](https://github.com/ai-infra-curriculum/.github/blob/main/CURRICULUM_CROSS_REFERENCE.md) for how modules connect.

technologies.IaC & CI/CD: Terraform, Pulumi, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI
technologies.LLMs & GPU: vLLM, Llama, Mistral, RAG, CUDA, NCCL, TensorRT
